# wordstats

Counts the words in a piece of text.

Run the tests: `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.

request: When you get a chance: wordstats needs a way to get just the most frequent words. Write `top_words(text, n)` returning a list of (word, count) tuples, most frequent first and ties broken alphabetically, importable as `from wordstats import top_words`. Thanks!

checks.code:
from wordstats import top_words
assert top_words("b a b c a b", 2) == [("b", 3), ("a", 2)]
assert top_words("b a", 5) == [("a", 1), ("b", 1)]
assert top_words("", 3) == []
assert top_words("x y", 0) == []
